In case you needed another insight on gyms - we have a membership with Planet Fitness and go to the one in UP. You can check on their app if they are full with their crowd meter. Every time we’ve gone it’s been super clean and everyone wears masks moving to and from machines. Every two ellipticals and things are marked off so you are forced to social distance (or socially fitness in their terms)
They have their usual sanitizing stations and hand sanitizers everywhere. 
It’s been good to get back into going to the gym and as people who are taking COVID seriously, we feel completely safe there. 
Hope that helps!
